generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of storm and flood preparation (暴风雨与防洪准备). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Depict residents finishing flood preparation outside one ground-floor home before a storm, with no active disaster. Build a short sandbag wall across the lower foreground and fit one flood barrier across the doorway. A person in chest waders checks the portable pump to the side, keeping it visible. Stack the waterproof box, water crate and food pack separately on a dry raised porch; set the lantern and battery radio on top without labels. One storm shutter is partly secured over a window. Moody overcast daylight, light wind and damp ground, structurally believable protection, no deep floodwater, lightning or panic.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: sandbag wall, portable water pump, doorway flood barrier, waterproof storage box, emergency lantern, battery radio, crate of bottled water, emergency food pack, rubber chest waders, storm shutter.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
